written.myAnswer: Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal pattern, while graphite consists of many such layers stacked together.
Graphene is important in electronics because it conducts electricity very well and can be used in electronic devices.

Allotropy is the existence of an element in different structural forms in the same physical state. Carbon occurs as diamond, graphite and Buckminster fullerene. Diamond has a giant macromolecular structure; graphite has layers of hexagonal carbon rings; and C₆₀ fullerene is a cage-like sphere made of pentagons and hexagons. Sulphur occurs as rhombic and monoclinic forms. Both contain S₈ molecules but differ in their crystal structures; rhombic sulphur is stable at room temperature, while monoclinic sulphur is stable at higher temperatures. Coal is an impure, amorphous form of carbon, whereas diamond is a crystalline form.
Graphene’s excellent electrical conductivity makes it very useful in electronics.
